entries.section: 6. The song of the three young men:

paragraphs.text: Then the three, with one mouth, began to praise God, to glorify Him and to bless Him in the furnace. We shall speak of this wonderful hymn, which the Church uses daily, when we discuss the second canonical books, God willing.
* God is in His place even now; He is in our midst, He who of old made the fire of the furnace in Babylon cool.

St. Basil the Great * The three young men were righteous; they cried out to the Lord while in the furnace, and as they praised, the fire became cool. The flame could not come near to harm the innocent and upright young men, since they praised God, and He delivered them from the flame.
* It is clear that He did not forsake the three young men who praised in the furnace; the flames could not touch them.
